meta.title: Speaker Provincial Assembly to act as, or perform functions of Governor in his absence:

versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Acting Governor.                                                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

When the Governor is absent from Pakistan or is unable to perform the functions of his office due to any cause, such other person as the President may direct shall act as Governor.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Eighteenth Amendment 2010-04-19 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Speaker Provincial Assembly to act as, or perform functions of Governor in his absence:    |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 19 April 2010                                                                               |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |
| Amendment 18 | https://pakistani.org/pakistan/constitution/amendments/18amendment.html |

When the Governor, by reason of absence from Pakistan or for any other cause, is unable to perform his functions, the Speaker of the Provincial Assembly and in his absence any other person as the President may nominate shall perform the functions of Governor until the Governor returns to Pakistan or, as the case may be, resumes his functions.
